partner.organizations._table: هویت حقوقی/عملیاتی سازمان گردشگری و وضعیت درخواست، احراز صلاحیت و مشارکت آن.
partner.organizations.organization_id: شناسه یکتای سازمان برای ارتباط با اعضا، خدمات و صندوق درخواست‌ها.
partner.organizations.legal_name: نام حقوقی سازمان طبق مدارک رسمی (داده هویتی؛ دسترسی محدود).
partner.organizations.display_name: عنوان نمایشی شرکت در محیط شریک و فهرست گیرندگان.
partner.organizations.organization_type: دسته سازمان مانند آژانس یا ارائه‌دهنده خدمت؛ مقادیر مجاز از enum/اعتبارسنجی API.
partner.organizations.registration_country: کشور ثبت حقوقی سازمان؛ کد/فرمت باید با اعتبارسنجی API تطبیق شود.
partner.organizations.created_by: شناسه کاربری که سازمان را ایجاد کرده است.
partner.organizations.verification_status: وضعیت احراز/تأیید سازمان توسط فرایند صاحب‌اختیار.
partner.organizations.participation_status: وضعیت فعال‌بودن مشارکت سازمان در سامانه.

_object.read_access: Member or explicitly granted organization reviewer, constrained by RLS.
_object.write_access: Owners/managers edit profile fields only; lifecycle transitions require the independent reviewer API.
_object.public_exposure: Private by default; only verified, approved, active, non-test organizations enter the eligibility view.
_object.api: GET/POST /api/v1/partners/organizations; PUT /api/v1/partners/organizations/{organization_id}; verification and separate reviewer decision routes.
_object.ui: PartnerWorkspace: company registration/profile and reviewer queue.

partner.organizations.registration_number: Optional legal registration identifier supplied by the organization; sensitive business identity data.
partner.organizations.primary_admin_area_id: Optional resolved reference to the organization?s primary administrative area.
partner.organizations.closed_at: Timestamp that the organization was closed; a closed organization is not share-eligible.
partner.organizations.is_test: Operator-controlled test-data marker; test organizations are excluded from share eligibility.

partner.memberships._table: عضویت کاربران در یک سازمان و نقش/فعال‌بودن آن‌ها.
partner.memberships.user_id: ارجاع به حساب شخص عضو سازمان.
partner.memberships.role: نقش عضو در سازمان؛ محدوده دسترسی از سیاست‌های مجوز استخراج شود.

_object.read_access: Organization members and reviewer capabilities only where policies allow.
_object.write_access: Created with company registration or invitation flow; no generic membership editor.
_object.api: Created internally by POST /organizations; no general membership CRUD route.
_object.ui: No ordinary user form; owner/member management is not exposed in this workspace.

partner.memberships.membership_id: Unique identifier for the organization membership.
partner.memberships.invited_by: Inviting user when membership originated from an invitation; nullable for owner registration.
partner.memberships.revoked_at: Timestamp that an active membership was revoked; must match revoked status.

partner.services._table: خدمات قابل ارائه توسط سازمان؛ اطلاعات عمومی خدمت از قرارداد انتشار جداست.
partner.services.branch_id: شعبه مرتبط، اگر خدمت شعبه‌محور باشد.
partner.services.service_type: نوع خدمت با مقادیر مجاز تعریف‌شده در API/دیتابیس.
partner.services.public_fields: فراداده/فیلدهای عمومی‌شدنی خدمت؛ کلیدهای JSON باید جداگانه مستند شوند.

_object.read_access: Active organization owner/manager/editor through membership RLS.
_object.write_access: Create/update private draft or submitted values; service key is generated server-side.
_object.public_exposure: Private until separately reviewed and published.
_object.ui: PartnerWorkspace first-service form and editable service list.

partner.services.internal_notes: Private organization-side notes; never part of public service output.
partner.services.updated_at: Timestamp of the latest service change.
partner.services.published_at: Publication timestamp; required only for published state and set by an authorized review path.

partner.service_localizations._table: نام و توضیح ترجمه‌شده خدمت در زبان‌های قابل پشتیبانی.
partner.service_localizations.locale: زبان/محل نمایشی، مانند fa-IR یا en-US بر اساس قرارداد API.
partner.service_localizations.display_name: نام نمایشی خدمت در آن زبان.

_object.read_access: Same organization membership and service-review policy.
_object.write_access: Written as part of service create/update API; no independent SQL form.
_object.public_exposure: Only approved published content can be public.
_object.api: POST/PUT service routes accept locale, display_name and description.

partner.service_localizations.content_status: Locale content lifecycle: draft, submitted, approved, rejected, or withdrawn.
partner.service_localizations.reviewed_at: Timestamp of editorial review when present.
partner.service_localizations.updated_at: Timestamp of the latest localization update.

partner.schedules._table: زمان‌بندی خدمت و بازه اعتبار اطلاعات زمانی.
partner.schedules.schedule_type: دسته زمان‌بندی و الگوی اجرای آن.
partner.schedules.timezone: شناسه منطقه زمانی معتبر IANA، در صورت انطباق با قرارداد.
partner.schedules.recurrence: قاعده تکرار؛ فرمت دقیق از API/SQL.
partner.schedules.observed_at: زمان آخرین مشاهده/تأیید این داده زمانی.

_object.write_access: Create/edit draft schedule; all instants use ISO timestamp and explicit time zone when times exist.
_object.public_exposure: Private unless independently reviewed. Freshness is controlled by observed_at/valid_until.
_object.ui: PartnerWorkspace optional schedule form and edit list.

partner.offers._table: پیشنهاد تجاری/بسته خدمت که ممکن است زمان‌بندی و ظرفیت داشته باشد.
partner.offers.capacity_limit: حداکثر ظرفیت قابل ارائه؛ واحد از قرارداد API.

_object.write_access: Create/edit unpublished offer; capacity is non-negative and published state is reviewer-controlled.
_object.ui: PartnerWorkspace optional offer form and edit list.

partner.offers.created_by: User account that created the offer.
partner.offers.updated_at: Timestamp of the latest editable offer change.
partner.offers.published_at: Publication timestamp; a published offer must have this value and publication is reviewer-controlled.

partner.prices._table: اقلام قیمت پیشنهادی همراه واحد و کیفیت/اعتبار ثبت مبلغ.
partner.prices.price_state: وضعیت معتبر بودن، اعلام‌نشده بودن یا برآوردی‌بودن مبلغ.
partner.prices.amount: مقدار عددی مبلغ مطابق precision و scale ستون.
partner.prices.currency: واحد پول/کد ارز؛ با denomination و unit اشتباه نشود.
partner.prices.denomination: مقیاس نمایشی مبلغ مانند میلیون؛ واحدهای واقعی باید از قرارداد استخراج شوند.
partner.prices.unit: مبنای قیمت مثل نفر/شب/خدمت (بسته به enum/قرارداد).

_object.read_access: Organization member according to price RLS.
_object.write_access: POST observation only; previous observations are preserved.
_object.public_exposure: Not a guaranteed current price; validity and source provenance must be shown.

partner.prices.tax_included: Whether the asserted amount includes tax; nullable when not known or not applicable.
partner.prices.valid_from: Start of the stated price validity interval, when provided.
partner.prices.source_kind: Price provenance: partner_asserted, approved_feed, or platform_observation.

partner.share_eligible_organizations._table: نمای فقط‌خواندنی سازمان‌های فعال و تأییدشده که می‌توانند درخواست مسافر دریافت کنند.

_object.read_access: Application can read the view; rows are not directly writable.
_object.public_exposure: Visible as recipient choices only through traveler share-options endpoint after authentication.
_object.ui: TravelerWorkspace company-sharing selector; absent when there are no eligible organizations.

partner.traveler_request_shares._table: اشتراک‌گذاری موردی و رضایت‌مندانه درخواست یک سفر با یک سازمان.
partner.traveler_request_shares.consent_policy_version: نسخه قرارداد رضایت معتبر هنگام اشتراک‌گذاری.
partner.traveler_request_shares.include_original_request: مشخص می‌کند متن اولیه خام درخواست نیز با رضایت صریح ضمیمه شده یا خیر.
partner.traveler_request_shares.consented_at: زمان اخذ رضایت و ایجاد دسترسی.
partner.traveler_request_shares.revoked_at: زمان لغو دسترسی، در صورت وقوع.

_object.read_access: Trip owner or active organization members while share is not revoked.
_object.write_access: Created only after explicit traveler consent; traveler may revoke.

partner.traveler_request_shares.created_at: Timestamp the explicit traveler-authorized share was created.

partner.traveler_request_revisions._table: نسخه‌های تغییرناپذیر/بازنگری‌شده درخواست و برنامه اشتراک‌گذاری‌شده با سازمان.
partner.traveler_request_revisions.revision_number: شماره ترتیبی نسخه برای همان اشتراک.
partner.traveler_request_revisions.event_kind: نوع رویداد نسخه مانند اشتراک جدید یا بازنگری.
partner.traveler_request_revisions.request_snapshot: نمای ثابت و محدودشده شرایط سفر در لحظه ارسال؛ اطلاعات شخصی باید کنترل دسترسی داشته باشد.
partner.traveler_request_revisions.itinerary_snapshot: نمای ثابت برنامه سفر در لحظه ارسال.
partner.traveler_request_revisions.is_synthetic: علامت داده آزمایشی؛ نباید در صندوق تولیدی به کاربر واقعی نشان داده شود.

_object.read_access: Only active recipient members and traveler while share remains active.
_object.write_access: Created by the revision-capture function; no direct client write grant.
_object.public_exposure: Private; snapshots can contain sensitive trip requirements.
_object.api: Read through protected organization request/revision routes.
_object.ui: PartnerWorkspace protected inbox and request/itinerary views.

partner.traveler_request_revisions.created_by: Traveler account whose authorized change generated this immutable revision.

conversation.conversations._table: ظرف مکالمه مسافر با دستیار پیرامون سفرهای ثبت‌شده.
conversation.conversations.user_id: مالک مکالمه و مبنای محدودسازی دسترسی.
conversation.conversations.version: شماره نسخه برای کنترل تعارض به‌روزرسانی.

conversation.messages._table: پیام‌های کاربر، دستیار یا سیستم در یک مکالمه.
conversation.messages.trip_id: شناسه سفر مرتبط، در صورت تعیین.
conversation.messages.content: متن پیام که ممکن است داده خصوصی سفر باشد؛ مستندساز فقط متادیتا می‌خواند.
conversation.messages.metadata: فراداده ساخت‌یافته پیام؛ قرارداد requirements_candidate و clarification و provisional_itinerary در کد Chat.

conversation.assistant_turns._table: ثبت شناسه یکتا، وضعیت و چرخه اجرای هر نوبت مدل در مکالمه.
conversation.assistant_turns.idempotency_key: کلید جلوگیری از اجرای تکراری یک درخواست.
conversation.assistant_turns.content_sha256: هش متن درخواست؛ مقدار واقعی نباید در سند منتشر شود.
conversation.assistant_turns.assistant_message_id: ارجاع به پیام خروجی دستیار پس از تکمیل.

integration.chat_daily_user_budget._table: سقف روزانه مصرف نوبت‌های دستیار برای هر کاربر.
integration.chat_daily_user_budget.budget_day: روز محاسبه سهمیه (در Backend از روز UTC استفاده شده است).

integration.chat_daily_global_budget._table: سقف کلی استفاده روزانه دستیار در سامانه.
integration.chat_daily_global_budget.budget_day: روز محاسبه سهمیه بر مبنای UTC.
integration.chat_daily_global_budget.hit_count: تعداد کل نوبت‌های مصرف‌شده در روز.

_object.read_access: Capability-check function is used by the server; table is operator-only.
_object.write_access: No application-role INSERT/UPDATE after migration 0024; no self-service grant route.
_object.api: No user-facing route; operator provisioning only.
_object.ui: No UI. Do not expose generic admin CRUD.

partner.platform_grants.capability: Granted platform permission: organization_review, service_review, or offer_review.
partner.platform_grants.granted_by: Operator user that issued the grant.
partner.platform_grants.revoked_at: Revocation timestamp; a non-NULL value disables the grant.

_object.write_access: No user-facing invitation route currently registered.
_object.public_exposure: Never public; token/email digest are sensitive.
_object.api: No application endpoint found in current partner router.

partner.invitations.invitation_id: Unique identifier for a membership invitation.
partner.invitations.email_digest: One-way digest of the target email; raw email is not stored in this field.
partner.invitations.token_hash: Unique one-way invitation token hash; never return the token hash to users.
partner.invitations.proposed_role: Role offered: manager, editor, availability_operator, or viewer.
partner.invitations.invited_by: User account that issued the invitation.
partner.invitations.expires_at: Timestamp after which the invitation cannot be accepted.

_object.read_access: Submitting organization owner/manager; separate reviewer capability for decisions.
_object.write_access: POST submission; verification decision only through reviewer capability; self-review is forbidden.
_object.public_exposure: Private. Evidence references must be reviewed independently.
_object.ui: PartnerWorkspace evidence submission and reviewer queue.

partner.verification_cases._table: Organization evidence submission and reviewer decision lifecycle.
partner.verification_cases.case_id: Unique identifier for one organization verification submission.
partner.verification_cases.status: Verification case lifecycle: draft, submitted, needs_information, verified, rejected, or withdrawn.
partner.verification_cases.evidence_refs: JSON array of evidence references submitted for independent review; values are untrusted until checked.
partner.verification_cases.submitted_by: User account that submitted the evidence.
partner.verification_cases.reviewer_user_id: Independent reviewer account; must differ from submitter for a final decision.
partner.verification_cases.policy_version: Identifier of the review policy used.
partner.verification_cases.decision_reason: Reviewer rationale, if a decision has been made.

_object.read_access: RLS is present; no branch endpoint is implemented in the current API router.
_object.write_access: No user-facing write API currently found.
_object.public_exposure: Not public absent later review/publication. Coordinates are not presumed to be entrances.
_object.ui: No form in this workspace; location entry is intentionally absent.

partner.branches._table: Optional service-location record with explicit coordinate role.
partner.branches.branch_id: Unique identifier for an organization branch/service location.
partner.branches.address_text: Partner-provided address text; not independently geocoded.
partner.branches.admin_area_id: Reference to a canonical administrative-area record when resolved.
partner.branches.location: PostGIS Point in SRID 4326; the role column determines whether it is an approximate reference, service location, or entrance.
partner.branches.location_role: Coordinate role: service_location, entrance, approximate_reference, or unknown; entrance requires a coordinate source.
partner.branches.coordinate_source: Provenance for coordinates; required for an entrance role.
partner.branches.contact_public: Partner-provided contact detail intended for public display only after applicable review.
partner.branches.status: Lifecycle state: draft, submitted, approved, suspended, or withdrawn.
partner.branches.updated_at: Timestamp of the latest profile update.

_object.read_access: Organization membership RLS; destination must resolve through production catalogue view.
_object.write_access: POST only in current API; relationship is not a publication decision.
_object.public_exposure: Private draft link; destination identity remains canonical.
_object.ui: PartnerWorkspace optional destination-link form; only API-returned published choices.

partner.service_destinations._table: Relationship from a company service to a canonical published destination.
partner.service_destinations.service_id: Organization-owned service related to the canonical destination.
partner.service_destinations.destination_id: Canonical destination identifier; API accepts only currently published destinations.
partner.service_destinations.relation_type: Relationship: at, serves, near, or route_endpoint.
partner.service_destinations.evidence_note: Optional partner-supplied context for this association; not verification evidence by itself.
partner.service_destinations.status: Review lifecycle: draft, submitted, approved, rejected, or withdrawn.

_object.read_access: Organization member according to availability RLS.
_object.write_access: POST observation only; do not overwrite history.
_object.public_exposure: Freshness limited by observed_at/valid_until; unknown remains unknown.

partner.availability_snapshots._table: Time-bounded availability observation, not a future guarantee.
partner.availability_snapshots.snapshot_id: Unique identifier for one time-bounded availability observation.
partner.availability_snapshots.organization_id: Owning partner organization; tenant boundary used by foreign keys and RLS.
partner.availability_snapshots.schedule_id: Related schedule occurrence source; nullable when the observation is not schedule-specific.
partner.availability_snapshots.occurrence_starts_at: Start instant of the observed service occurrence, stored as timestamptz.
partner.availability_snapshots.occurrence_ends_at: End instant of that occurrence when known; must not precede its start.
partner.availability_snapshots.availability_state: Observed state: available, unavailable, limited, unknown, or conflicting.
partner.availability_snapshots.available_count: Non-negative observed count when applicable; NULL is required for unknown state.
partner.availability_snapshots.source_kind: Provenance class: partner_asserted, approved_feed, or platform_observation.
partner.availability_snapshots.observed_at: Instant when availability was observed; required for available state.
partner.availability_snapshots.valid_from: Start of the interval for which this observation is represented as valid.
partner.availability_snapshots.valid_until: End of the validity interval; do not treat stale data as current.
partner.availability_snapshots.created_by: User account that submitted the observation, if recorded.

_object.read_access: Reviewer/authorized backend paths; no general table access.
_object.write_access: Written within audited decision routes only; no generic CRUD.
_object.api: Inserted by organization verification/application/participation decision endpoints.
_object.ui: Reviewer decision controls; no audit editor.

partner.review_events.review_event_id: Unique identifier for an immutable review audit event.
partner.review_events.entity_type: Reviewed object type: organization, verification_case, branch, service, offer, price, schedule, or availability.
partner.review_events.entity_id: Identifier of the reviewed object within the declared entity type.
partner.review_events.decision: Audited action: approve, reject, request_changes, suspend, reinstate, activate, or deactivate.
partner.review_events.reviewer_user_id: User account that performed the review action.
partner.review_events.policy_version: Version of the decision policy applied.
partner.review_events.occurred_at: Timestamp when the review action occurred.

_object.write_access: System-created on each revision; client can mark viewed only.

partner.traveler_request_inbox._table: Organization-scoped notification for a request revision.
partner.traveler_request_inbox.inbox_event_id: Unique identifier of the organization inbox event.
partner.traveler_request_inbox.revision_id: Private request revision represented by the inbox event.
partner.traveler_request_inbox.created_at: Timestamp when the inbox event was created.
partner.traveler_request_inbox.viewed_at: Timestamp the authorized member marked the event viewed.

_object.read_access: Authorized recipient members and the traveler owning the trip.
_object.write_access: Company submits response; traveler alone updates decision state.
_object.public_exposure: Private; amounts are proposal fields, not booking/payment transactions.
_object.api: POST/GET organization request responses; traveler response and decision routes.

partner.trip_company_responses._table: Company response to an authorized traveler request revision and traveler decision.
partner.trip_company_responses.response_id: Unique identifier for the company response.
partner.trip_company_responses.client_request_id: Client-provided idempotency identifier, unique within a share.
partner.trip_company_responses.revision_id: Exact shared request revision the response addresses.
partner.trip_company_responses.trip_id: Traveler trip referenced by the share.
partner.trip_company_responses.traveler_id: Trip owner who receives and decides the response.
partner.trip_company_responses.submitted_by: Authorized company member who submitted the response.
partner.trip_company_responses.proposed_price_toman: Optional proposed price in Iranian toman; this is not a payment or booking transaction.
partner.trip_company_responses.proposed_start_date: Optional proposed Gregorian ISO date; set together with proposed_end_date.
partner.trip_company_responses.proposed_end_date: Optional proposed Gregorian ISO date; must be on or after proposed_start_date.
partner.trip_company_responses.proposed_schedule_notes: Optional counter-offer schedule notes, maximum 1500 characters.
partner.trip_company_responses.traveler_decision: Traveler-only decision: pending, accepted, or declined.
partner.trip_company_responses.decided_at: Timestamp of traveler decision; NULL exactly while decision is pending.
partner.trip_company_responses.is_synthetic: Test marker constrained to false for persisted company responses.
